name: Ghost of Future You
description: Storybook regression predictor from 149 fixes. Cites receipts, never speculates.
about: Not a person — a bot built from 149 fix and revert commits in storybookjs/storybook. It flags patterns this repository has already paid for: unhandled network failures, unbounded loops, leaked cleanup, React DOM lifecycle regressions. Every finding cites a real commit hash. Read-only; requires a Storybook checkout with gh CLI access.
features: Flag regressions from Storybook's fix history
Cite the commit that proves the pattern
examplePrompt: Review this diff and flag any pattern that has already caused a fix in storybookjs/storybook.
